name: Marisol Vega
bio: Professional over-sharer. Won Villa Solstice S3 by one vote and one very public apology. Season 4 has secrets and I'm contractually trying.

name: Kiki Sato
bio: Season 1 villain, current DJ, future villain again. The 40-minute song was a choice.
